name: CMS IntelliCAD - Đồng bộ Báo giá Google Sheet

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS data),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    nullif(trim(data->>'Mã đồng bộ'),'') sync_key,
    nullif(trim(data->>'Mã lead'),'') lead_id,
    nullif(trim(data->>'quote_id'),'') quote_id,
    nullif(trim(data->>'conversation_id'),'') conversation_id,
    nullif(trim(data->>'product_id'),'') product_id,
    nullif(trim(data->>'assigned_user_id'),'') assigned_user_id_raw,
    trim(coalesce(data->>'Nhân viên phụ trách','')) assigned_name,
    CASE lower(trim(coalesce(data->>'Nguồn lead','')))
      WHEN 'facebook' THEN 'facebook' WHEN 'website' THEN 'web' WHEN 'web' THEN 'web'
      WHEN 'zalo' THEN 'zalo' WHEN 'telegram' THEN 'telegram'
      ELSE lower(trim(coalesce(data->>'Nguồn lead',''))) END source,
    trim(coalesce(data->>'Tên khách hàng','')) customer_name,
    regexp_replace(coalesce(data->>'Số điện thoại',''),'[^+0-9]','','g') phone,
    trim(coalesce(data->>'Email','')) email,
    trim(coalesce(data->>'Công ty','')) company,
    CASE lower(trim(coalesce(data->>'Loại khách hàng','')))
      WHEN 'cá nhân' THEN 'personal' WHEN 'personal' THEN 'personal'
      WHEN 'doanh nghiệp' THEN 'business' WHEN 'business' THEN 'business'
      ELSE 'unknown' END customer_type,
    CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(data->>'Số lượng','')) ~ '^[0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?$'
      THEN replace(trim(data->>'Số lượng'),',','.')::numeric END quantity,
    trim(coalesce(data->>'Nhu cầu','')) need,
    lower(trim(coalesce(data->>'Trạng thái lead',''))) lead_status,
    CASE lower(trim(coalesce(data->>'Trạng thái báo giá','')))
      WHEN 'new' THEN 'new' WHEN 'chưa báo giá' THEN ''
      WHEN 'reviewing' THEN 'reviewing' WHEN 'đang xử lý' THEN 'reviewing'
      WHEN 'sent' THEN 'sent' WHEN 'đã gửi' THEN 'sent'
      WHEN 'accepted' THEN 'accepted' WHEN 'đồng ý' THEN 'accepted'
      WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' WHEN 'từ chối' THEN 'rejected'
      WHEN 'expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN 'hết hạn' THEN 'expired'
      WHEN 'closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN 'đã đóng' THEN 'closed'
      ELSE lower(trim(coalesce(data->>'Trạng thái báo giá',''))) END quote_status,
    CASE
      WHEN trim(coalesce(data->>'Lần liên hệ gần nhất',''))='' THEN NULL
      WHEN trim(data->>'Lần liên hệ gần nhất') ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$'
        THEN (to_timestamp(trim(data->>'Lần liên hệ gần nhất'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN trim(data->>'Lần liên hệ gần nhất') ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}$'
        THEN (to_timestamp(trim(data->>'Lần liên hệ gần nhất'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN trim(data->>'Lần liên hệ gần nhất') ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
        THEN trim(data->>'Lần liên hệ gần nhất')::timestamptz END last_contacted_at,
    CASE
      WHEN trim(coalesce(data->>'Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo',''))='' THEN NULL
      WHEN trim(data->>'Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo') ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$'
        THEN (to_timestamp(trim(data->>'Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN trim(data->>'Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo') ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}$'
        THEN (to_timestamp(trim(data->>'Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN trim(data->>'Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo') ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
        THEN trim(data->>'Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo')::timestamptz END next_follow_up_at,
    nullif(left(trim(coalesce(data->>'Ghi chú nhân viên','')),2000),'') staff_note,
    nullif(trim(data->>'db_hash'),'') db_hash
  FROM input
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT n.*,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(n.assigned_name) IN ('','ai assistant') THEN NULL
      WHEN n.assigned_user_id_raw ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_profiles u WHERE u.id=n.assigned_user_id_raw::uuid AND u.status='active')
        THEN n.assigned_user_id_raw::uuid
      ELSE (SELECT u.id FROM user_profiles u WHERE u.status='active'
        AND lower(trim(coalesce(u.full_name,'')))=lower(n.assigned_name)
        ORDER BY u.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)
    END assigned_user_id
  FROM normalized n
),
hashed AS (
  SELECT r.*,md5(concat_ws(chr(31),'company-sheet-v2',r.source,r.customer_name,r.phone,r.email,r.company,r.customer_type,
    coalesce(trim(to_char(r.quantity,'FM9999999990.########')),''),r.need,r.lead_status,r.quote_status,
    coalesce(r.assigned_user_id::text,''),
    coalesce(to_char(r.last_contacted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),''),
    coalesce(to_char(r.next_follow_up_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),''),
    coalesce(r.staff_note,''))) sheet_hash
  FROM resolved r
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM hashed
  WHERE sync_key IS NOT NULL AND db_hash IS NOT NULL AND sheet_hash<>db_hash
    AND lead_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND conversation_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND product_id='1369' AND sync_key='lead:'||lead_id
),
lead_update AS (
  UPDATE leads l SET
    source=CASE WHEN v.source<>'' THEN left(v.source,80) ELSE l.source END,
    full_name=CASE WHEN v.customer_name<>'' THEN left(v.customer_name,160) ELSE l.full_name END,
    phone=CASE WHEN v.phone ~ '^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$' THEN v.phone ELSE l.phone END,
    email=CASE WHEN v.email='' THEN NULL WHEN v.email ~* '^[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}$' THEN left(v.email,200) ELSE l.email END,
    company=nullif(left(v.company,200),''),customer_type=v.customer_type,
    requested_quantity=CASE WHEN v.quantity>0 AND v.quantity<=100000 THEN v.quantity ELSE l.requested_quantity END,
    need=CASE WHEN v.need<>'' THEN left(v.need,2000) ELSE l.need END,
    status=CASE WHEN v.lead_status=ANY(ARRAY['new','contacted','qualified','quoted','won','lost','closed']) THEN v.lead_status ELSE l.status END,
    assigned_user_id=v.assigned_user_id,last_contacted_at=v.last_contacted_at,
    next_follow_up_at=v.next_follow_up_at,staff_note=v.staff_note,sheet_last_edited_at=now(),updated_at=now()
  FROM valid v
  WHERE l.id=v.lead_id::uuid AND l.conversation_id=v.conversation_id::uuid AND l.product_id=1369
  RETURNING l.id,l.conversation_id,l.product_id
),
quote_update AS (
  UPDATE quote_requests q SET
    customer_name=CASE WHEN v.customer_name<>'' THEN left(v.customer_name,160) ELSE q.customer_name END,
    phone=CASE WHEN v.phone ~ '^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$' THEN v.phone ELSE q.phone END,
    email=CASE WHEN v.email='' THEN NULL WHEN v.email ~* '^[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}$' THEN left(v.email,200) ELSE q.email END,
    company=nullif(left(v.company,200),''),notes=CASE WHEN v.need<>'' THEN left(v.need,2000) ELSE q.notes END,
    status=CASE WHEN v.quote_status=ANY(ARRAY['new','reviewing','sent','accepted','rejected','expired','closed']) THEN v.quote_status ELSE q.status END,
    updated_at=now()
  FROM valid v
  WHERE v.quote_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND q.id=v.quote_id::uuid AND q.conversation_id=v.conversation_id::uuid
  RETURNING q.id
),
item_update AS (
  UPDATE quote_request_items i SET quantity=v.quantity
  FROM valid v
  WHERE v.quote_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND i.quote_request_id=v.quote_id::uuid AND i.product_id=1369 AND i.product_version_id IS NULL
    AND v.quantity>0 AND v.quantity<=100000
  RETURNING i.id
),
state_pending AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_sheet_sync_state(lead_id,sync_status,last_attempt_at,error_message,sheet_row_key,updated_at)
  SELECT v.lead_id::uuid,'pending',now(),NULL,v.sync_key,now() FROM valid v
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO UPDATE SET sync_status='pending',last_attempt_at=now(),error_message=NULL,updated_at=now()
  RETURNING lead_id
)
SELECT coalesce((SELECT sync_key FROM valid LIMIT 1),'') sync_key,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_update) lead_changed,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quote_update) quote_changed,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM item_update) item_changed;

parameters.query:
WITH rows AS (
  SELECT 'lead:'||l.id::text sync_key,l.id::text lead_id,q.request_code,
    CASE lower(coalesce(l.source,'')) WHEN 'facebook' THEN 'Facebook' WHEN 'web' THEN 'Website'
      WHEN 'zalo' THEN 'Zalo' WHEN 'telegram' THEN 'Telegram' ELSE coalesce(l.source,'') END source_display,
    'CMS IntelliCAD'::text product,coalesce(q.customer_name,l.full_name,'') customer_name,
    coalesce(q.phone,l.phone,'') phone,coalesce(q.email,l.email,'') email,
    coalesce(q.company,l.company,'') company,
    CASE l.customer_type WHEN 'personal' THEN 'Cá nhân' WHEN 'business' THEN 'Doanh nghiệp' ELSE 'Chưa xác định' END customer_type_display,
    coalesce(qi.quantity,l.requested_quantity) quantity,coalesce(q.notes,l.need,'') need,
    coalesce(l.status,'') lead_status,coalesce(q.status,'') quote_status,
    coalesce(nullif(trim(u.full_name),''),'AI Assistant') assigned_name,l.assigned_user_id,
    l.last_contacted_at,l.next_follow_up_at,coalesce(l.staff_note,'') staff_note,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(l.source,''))='facebook'
      THEN 'https://business.facebook.com/latest/inbox/all?asset_id='||coalesce(ca.external_account_id,ca.config->>'page_id',ca.secret_ref,'')||'&selected_item_id='||c.external_user_id
      ELSE '' END conversation_link,
    least(coalesce(l.created_at,q.created_at),coalesce(q.created_at,l.created_at)) created_at,
    greatest(coalesce(l.updated_at,q.updated_at),coalesce(q.updated_at,l.updated_at)) record_updated_at,
    l.sheet_last_edited_at,coalesce(ss.sync_status,'pending') sync_status,q.id::text quote_id,l.conversation_id::text conversation_id,l.product_id::text product_id
  FROM leads l
  JOIN conversations c ON c.id=l.conversation_id
  JOIN channel_accounts ca ON ca.id=c.channel_account_id
  LEFT JOIN user_profiles u ON u.id=l.assigned_user_id
  LEFT JOIN lead_sheet_sync_state ss ON ss.lead_id=l.id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT qr.* FROM quote_requests qr JOIN quote_request_items item ON item.quote_request_id=qr.id
    WHERE qr.conversation_id=l.conversation_id AND item.product_id=l.product_id
      AND ((nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.phone,''),'[^0-9]','','g'),'') IS NOT NULL
        AND regexp_replace(coalesce(qr.phone,''),'[^0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(coalesce(l.phone,''),'[^0-9]','','g'))
      OR (nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.phone,''),'[^0-9]','','g'),'') IS NULL
        AND nullif(lower(trim(coalesce(l.email,''))),'') IS NOT NULL
        AND lower(trim(coalesce(qr.email,'')))=lower(trim(l.email))))
    ORDER BY qr.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
  ) q ON true
  LEFT JOIN quote_request_items qi ON qi.quote_request_id=q.id AND qi.product_id=l.product_id AND qi.product_version_id IS NULL
  WHERE l.product_id=1369
), hashed AS (
  SELECT r.*,md5(concat_ws(chr(31),'company-sheet-v2',lower(coalesce(NULLIF(r.source_display,''),'')),r.customer_name,
    r.phone,r.email,r.company,CASE r.customer_type_display WHEN 'Cá nhân' THEN 'personal' WHEN 'Doanh nghiệp' THEN 'business' ELSE 'unknown' END,
    coalesce(trim(to_char(r.quantity,'FM9999999990.########')),''),r.need,r.lead_status,CASE WHEN r.quote_status IN ('','new') THEN '' ELSE r.quote_status END,
    coalesce(r.assigned_user_id::text,''),
    coalesce(to_char(r.last_contacted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),''),
    coalesce(to_char(r.next_follow_up_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),''),r.staff_note)) db_hash
  FROM rows r
)
SELECT lead_id AS "Mã lead",coalesce(request_code,'') AS "Mã báo giá",source_display AS "Nguồn lead",
  product AS "Sản phẩm",customer_name AS "Tên khách hàng",CASE WHEN phone<>'' THEN chr(39)||phone ELSE '' END AS "Số điện thoại",email AS "Email",
  company AS "Công ty",customer_type_display AS "Loại khách hàng",
  coalesce(trim(to_char(quantity,'FM9999999990.########')),'') AS "Số lượng",need AS "Nhu cầu",
  upper(lead_status) AS "Trạng thái lead",
  CASE quote_status WHEN '' THEN 'CHƯA BÁO GIÁ' WHEN 'new' THEN 'CHƯA BÁO GIÁ'
    WHEN 'reviewing' THEN 'ĐANG XỬ LÝ' WHEN 'sent' THEN 'ĐÃ GỬI' WHEN 'accepted' THEN 'ĐỒNG Ý'
    WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'TỪ CHỐI' WHEN 'expired' THEN 'HẾT HẠN' WHEN 'closed' THEN 'ĐÃ ĐÓNG'
    ELSE upper(quote_status) END AS "Trạng thái báo giá",
  assigned_name AS "Nhân viên phụ trách",
  coalesce(to_char(last_contacted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'') AS "Lần liên hệ gần nhất",
  coalesce(to_char(next_follow_up_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'') AS "Lịch liên hệ tiếp theo",
  staff_note AS "Ghi chú nhân viên",conversation_link AS "Link hội thoại",
  coalesce(to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'),'') AS "Ngày tạo lead",
  coalesce(to_char(record_updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'') AS "Cập nhật lần cuối",
  coalesce(to_char(coalesce(sheet_last_edited_at,record_updated_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'') AS "Cập nhật DB",
  upper(sync_status) AS "Trạng thái đồng bộ",sync_key AS "Mã đồng bộ",coalesce(quote_id,'') AS "quote_id",
  conversation_id AS "conversation_id",product_id AS "product_id",
  coalesce(assigned_user_id::text,'') AS "assigned_user_id",db_hash AS "db_hash"
FROM hashed ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST;

nodes.name: Đọc Hồ sơ Báo giá từ Database

parameters.jsCode: const dbItems=$input.all();const sheetItems=$('Đọc Sheet Báo giá').all();const existing=new Map(sheetItems.map(item=>[String(item.json?.['Mã đồng bộ']||''),item.json||{}]).filter(([key])=>key));const systemFields=['Mã lead','Mã báo giá','Trạng thái đồng bộ','quote_id','conversation_id','product_id','assigned_user_id'];return dbItems.filter(item=>{const row=item.json||{},old=existing.get(String(row['Mã đồng bộ']||''));if(!old)return true;if(String(old.db_hash||'')!==String(row.db_hash||''))return true;return systemFields.some(key=>String(old[key]||'')!==String(row[key]||''));});

nodes.name: Chỉ đẩy dòng Database thay đổi

parameters.query: INSERT INTO lead_sheet_sync_state(lead_id,sync_status,last_attempt_at,synced_at,error_message,sheet_row_key,db_hash,updated_at) VALUES (($1::jsonb->>'lead_id')::uuid,'synced',now(),now(),NULL,$1::jsonb->>'sync_key',$1::jsonb->>'db_hash',now()) ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO UPDATE SET sync_status='synced',last_attempt_at=now(),synced_at=now(),error_message=NULL,sheet_row_key=excluded.sheet_row_key,db_hash=excluded.db_hash,updated_at=now() RETURNING lead_id,sync_status,synced_at;
